business.text: A pre-order website for a small bakery where regular customers can reserve their usual bread ahead of time.

positioning.text: Solves the problem of favourite loaves selling out by letting regulars guarantee their usual order, while helping the bakery plan baking quantities.

customers.text: The bakery's regular customers who come every morning and have their usual loaves, especially those frustrated when their favourites like sourdough sell out by nine.

whatSells.text: The guarantee that regulars can hold their usual loaf and never face the disappointment of it being sold out.

brandFeel.text: Familiar and effortless, like the baker already knows you; no unnecessary questions.

strengths.text: She excels at talking with customers and translating what they say into product decisions. She loves this direct customer connection and building from real needs.

waysOfWorking.text: She works best when she can stay close to customers and use their voice to guide what gets built.

philosophy.believe: Our first users are the regulars who come every morning and get frustrated when their favourite bread sells out.
philosophy.guidance: Focus the first version on letting regulars reserve their usual loaf so they're guaranteed to get it. Build for this morning rush problem first, then expand from there.

philosophy.believe: The experience should feel like walking into a shop where they know your name and your usual order.
philosophy.guidance: Don't make regulars fill in details the bakery already has. Pre-fill their usual order, their name, their pickup time. Make ordering feel like a nod to someone who knows you.
